motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Council request the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) to report on the department's Energization Process Improvement, as requested by Executive Directive No. 19, including but not limited to specifics about inspection process improvements, proactive review workflows, plan to improve internal communication, and a timeline for rolling efforts out. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council request LADWP to report back on the total number of multifamily and mixed use electrical requests requiring new or upgraded service, including data on whether the project is 100% affordable or market-rate, ED-1 or non, service size (amps), current status and how long it has taken to bring buildings online from August 1,2021 to present. I FURTHER MOVE that the City Council request LADWP to report back on the total number of current vacancies, strategies to reduce turnover and incentivize retainment, and what actions the department takes to transition between employees and customers to ensure that it doesn’t delay ongoing projects. PRESENTED BY L <C& YSAE EL JURADO Courcilmember, 14th District MP AUG 2 6 2026 SECONDED BY olelole/
title: Energization Process Improvement / Department of Water and Power / Inspection Process Improvements / Proactive Review Workflows / Improve Internal Communication

requests.asks: Report on the Energization Process Improvement including inspection process improvements, proactive review workflows, and internal communication plan; on multifamily and mixed use electrical requests and service data by affordable/market-rate and project status; and on staffing vacancies, turnover reduction strategies, and employee transition procedures.
